- In Faust, **connecting DSP functions** can be done using the ***sequential operator*** '**`:`**'.

## Faust: Basics (2) {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 95%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- In Faust, **connecting DSP functions** can be done using the ***sequential operator*** '**`:`**'.
- The ***split operator*** '**`<:`**' and ***cable operator*** can also be used to connect a signal to **multiple targets**.
:::
- On the other hand, the ***merge operator*** '**`:>`**' can be used to **merge** (**mix**) **signals together**.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.js code-line-numbers="3-5|7|" filename="examples/basics2/merge-cable.dsp"}
{{< include /faust/examples/basics2/merge-cable.dsp >}}
```
{{< faust faust/examples/basics2/merge-cable.dsp >}}
:::
::::

## Faust: Basics (2) {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 95%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- In Faust, **connecting DSP functions** can be done using the ***sequential operator*** '**`:`**'.
- The ***split operator*** '**`<:`**' and ***cable operator*** can also be used to connect a signal to **multiple targets**.
- On the other hand, the ***merge operator*** '**`:>`**' can be used to **merge** (**mix**) **signals together**.
:::
- *Graphical User Interface* (**GUI**) elements can be added to ***control parameters***: *sliders*, *buttons*, *switches*, *vu-meters*, etc.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.js code-line-numbers="3-5|7-8|" filename="examples/basics2/sliders.dsp"}
{{< include /faust/examples/basics2/sliders.dsp >}}
```
{{< faust faust/examples/basics2/sliders.dsp >}}
:::
::::

<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->
## Faust: Basics (2) {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 95%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
- In Faust, **connecting DSP functions** can be done using the ***sequential operator*** '**`:`**'.
- The ***split operator*** '**`<:`**' and ***cable operator*** can also be used to connect a signal to **multiple targets**.
- On the other hand, the ***merge operator*** '**`:>`**' can be used to **merge** (**mix**) **signals together**.
- *Graphical User Interface* (**GUI**) elements can be added to ***control parameters***: *sliders*, *buttons*, *switches*, *vu-meters*, etc.
:::
- They can be used to make a proper **gain control** in **dB** for example.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.js code-line-numbers="3-5|7-8|10|12|" filename="examples/basics2/gain.dsp"}
{{< include /faust/examples/basics2/gain.dsp >}}
```
{{< faust faust/examples/basics2/gain.dsp >}}
:::
